url.description: The project's homepage, or its repository if it has no homepage.

repo.description: The GitHub owner/name that the weekly checker watches. Leave it out for projects that aren't on GitHub.

role.description: program if it sends status reports, terminal if it shows them.

is_featured.description: Set true to feature an entry with fewer than 1,000 stars, or false to hide one with more. Leave it out to go by stars.

aliases.description: Other names that search should match, such as agentd for agtd.

spec_revision.description: The OSC 7501 spec revision of the last check, such as 0.4.

note.description: A caveat that the popover shows, such as how to turn support on.

last_checked_date.description: When a person last checked this entry. Leave it out if the weekly checker can follow its last history block.

popular.description: At least 1,000 GitHub stars at the last check.

latest_release_tag.description: The newest stable release. Kept only while the entry is working or blocked.

github.description: Written by the weekly checker. Don't edit it by hand.

date.description: When the state or its evidence changed. A date-time is in UTC.

state.description: The state from this date on.

source.description: The PR, commit, release, issue or docs page that shows this state.

history.description: State changes, oldest first. The last block is the current state, and no blocks means idle.
